items.title: Oliver Nelson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 10, 2020
items.q: a guy named Brent Wallarab... asked me to play on it. And I wanted some of my jazz for listening students to come.

ctx.x: We’re all in sort of this Zoom world and some of us are making it through better than others I guess.

Well it’s interesting, a guy named Brent Wallarab, he’s one that teaches at IU, he teaches arranging and composition and stuff. He’s doing this concert of my dad’s music and asked me to play on it. And I wanted some of my jazz for listening students to come. Well I talked to the head of the department and he said well I have to check and see. Because they might not let you. And these guys were having rehearsals, and everybody is so separated. So he’s trying to put them in clusters kind of close together so you…
You know I have a nine member saxophone ensemble and they constantly are slowing down. And I’m going what’s the problem. Well there’s 60 feet from one end to the other.
